description: The priced estimate — the canvas Estimate panel as data: one line per quantity kind each measured condition carries — its area, LF and EA are separate lines (unit, order and measured quantities, rates, material / labor / supply cost, main marks each condition's first line; status priced | partial | unpriced with what is missing, or optional — a bordered linear run's derived line nobody priced, carried in its main line and never missing; set_pricing prices any line: the main one by default, the others with line "LF" / "EA" / "SF"), then material, labor, sales tax, cost, overhead, profit and the base bid. complete is false while anything is unentered: the total then counts the missing pieces at $0 and is "priced so far", and unpriced lists every hole — report it to the estimator, never fill it. Read-only.
name: estimate_summary

key.description: "<condition id>:<unit>" — one line per quantity kind the condition carries

labor_qty.description: Measured quantity in the unit — no waste

main.description: The condition's first line: priced by pricing.unit / material / labor and carrying its assembly items; the others price from pricing.by_unit[unit]

material_qty.description: Order quantity in the unit — waste applied (EA never carries waste)

optional.description: A bordered linear run's derived line: priceable, but an empty rate is carried in the main line, never missing

status.description: optional = an optional line nobody priced (not in unpriced)

total.description: The base bid — 'priced so far' while complete is false

missing.description: What was never entered: "material", "labor", or "material row: <name>"

unit.description: Which of the condition's lines is unpriced
